preconditions.description: The number of routers n is between 2 and 200000 inclusive.
The length of the list p is exactly n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i < i for i, p_i in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: Each p_i is an integer between 1 and i-1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The path starts with 1 and ends with n.
All elements in the path are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(path[i] in p[:i] for i in range(1, len(path)))
postconditions.description: Each router in the path (except the first) is connected to the previous router in the path.
